# Feroxi
The Feroxi (fer-ox-i) are a race of humanoid shark-like beings. Carnivourous in nature with a strong bite force.
## Background Your species, the Feroxi, come from a semi-aquatic world filled with shallow oceans, wetlands, and storm-heavy coastlines. Your planet, known as Telea, was wracked with frequent floods and unstable land, leading to your kind’s evolution to adapt both in water and on land.
Your bodies are rough and rigid, almost built for hunting down prey and thrashing them with your jaws. Your tail allows you to move efficiently in water and balance steadily on land.
The Feroxi first formed communities along coastlines where they could access both sea and land resources; communication developed through gnashes of your sharp teeth and snarls amongst one another. But because of your flexible vocal structure, they were eventually able to copy the language of Tau-Ceti, and even learned to adapt to new languages. With practice and translation support, they learned to speak directly with foreign species that found their species.
When they encountered these foreign forces, both sides approached carefully. Shared interests in trade and exploration encouraged cooperation; and the Feroxi were known for their amicable, but fierce nature. Over time, they became known as a practical and adaptable species capable of working alongside others: and thus, were able to spread across the galaxy.
## Diet
- Can ONLY eat meat.
## Benefits
- Uses their jaws to do [color=#ec3a3a]Piercing[/color] damage, and harder than other species, rivaling Oni. - Their cartilaginous skeleton allows them to take [color=#1e90ff]10% less Blunt damage.[/color] - Their adaptation to native environments allows them to take [color=#1e90ff]10% less cold damage.[/color] - Their biology allows them to breathe water vapour.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#FFA500]10% more Slash damage.[/color] - Gets [color=#FFA500]thirsty 100% faster[/color]. - When thirst falls to "Parched," they begin to [color=#FFA500]suffocate.[/color] Have water handy! - Saline is too salty! It hydrates you much less! - Your lungs are non-removable, as they're integrated with your gills.
